prompt: I have dry eyes, what can I do to prevent that?
response: To prevent dry eyes, use over-the-counter eye drops as often as needed throughout the day. You can also increase the humidity in your home using a humidifier. If your dry eyes are related to computer use, try the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for at least 20 seconds to reduce eye strain.
